title: Top UFO expert says government 'hiding truth about aliens' in last interview
excerpt: EXCLUSIVE: He was the UK’s top UFO hunter until his untimely death in April. Now ex-MOD expert Nick Pope speaks out from beyond the grave to accuse the Government of hiding the truth about alien life
content:
A top UFO hunter accused the government of hiding the truth about aliens in his final interview before his death. Nick Pope – dubbed the real life Agent Mulder from the X Files – said: “They know there’s more to this than just weather balloons and aircraft lights.”

The former civil servant, who spent three years on the Ministry of Defence’s “UFO desk”, also insisted the world’s leaders know we are not alone in the universe. He made the bombshell claims in an upcoming TV documentary filmed just before his death.

He told presenter Bradley Walsh that during his time investigating the phenomenon of UFOs, he would get hundreds of reports of sightings each year and could confidently explain around 80% of them.

‌

But of the other 20%, he said: “We were not able to find a definitive result. Some of this doesn’t quite add up. Objects running rings around the cutting edge of our own aerospace tech. Speeds, manoeuvres, accelerations we can’t match.

“At the very least, I think it’s fair to say it was enough to make me take another look at this.”

Nick, who died of cancer in April, said he had no interest in extraterrestrial activity until 1991, when he was asked to investigate the phenomena of unidentified flying objects.

‌

He was interviewed by comedian and game show host Bradley for his upcoming Sky History show Out Of This World on Sky HISTORY, which starts on Tuesday. In the first episode, Bradley, 66, asks Nick if he thinks we are alone in the universe.

“We are definitely not”, the expert responds. “You know, the universe is nearly 14 billion years old. You’ve only got to imagine a civilisation with a million year, let alone a billion year headstart on us and all bets are off. So life out there, definitely.

“Us being visited, I’m less sure. I certainly hope so, because I tell you this, the world with aliens in it is going to be far more interesting and fun than the world with no aliens. So bring them on.”

‌

Nick goes on to warn that AI technology could prove a major obstacle for sleuths hoping to prove the existence of extraterrestrials.

He adds: “I think the technology, which you would think works for us, works against us. Now with the rise of AI, you don’t really know if something is real or not.

“This is one of the biggest and most profound questions we can ask as human beings. Are we alone or not in the universe? Are we being visited? If we got an answer to that, it would change the world forever.”

‌

Nick, who died shortly after speaking to Bradley, investigated about 1,000 unexplained sightings during his three years on the “UFO desk”.

After the department closed, he moved into the media, commenting on the unexplained, conspiracy theories, science fiction, and fringe science.

In his new show, Bradley says Nick was one of his heroes and he had been due to fly to Washington to meet him, but they were forced to talk over Zoom instead when he became very ill.

‌

The host of ITV game show The Chase is later seen delving into Britain’s declassified Ministry of Defence files. One shows Winston Churchill asked for a report into flying saucers in 1952.

He then heads to Rendlesham Forest, dubbed “Britain’s Roswell”, the scene of the country’s most famous alleged UFO incident.

At one point, he asks: “If people have seen them, and UFOs or aliens have visited, why haven’t people taken notice? Why isn’t it on the News at 10? Are the news corporations keeping it from us? What is going on? I have no idea.

“It’s pretty naive of us to imagine that we’re the only planet sustainable of life in the entire universe. There’s gotta be something out there.” The Ministry of Defence did not respond to a request for comment.

‌

Bradley Walsh: Out of This World, all episodes available on Tuesday on Sky HISTORY and HISTORY Play.
